title: Barbara W NDE 3939/4183 NDE 4183
content:
4183 I had suffered a bleed from a cerebral aneurysm and was in hospital, in intensive care. At some point while there, I was travelling, following a very bright light. This presence was communicating with me, telling me not to be afraid and that I would no longer have any worries or cares. We were in a green field, filled with beautiful flowers, a tree and a brook. We arrived at a small white bridge that went over the brook and I was ready to cross it but the presence stopped me and said, ‘You can cross the creek, but you have three small children on this side’. I chose not to cross so that I could be with my children.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Cerebral Aneurysm 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I had a cerebral aneurysm and was hospitalized. I was not aware of much for quite a while. After I got home my family said the doctors told them that I had been given a 10 percent chance of survival. | Yes Illness 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Cerebral aneurysm that had burst.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | A landscape or city | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body | No I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal At the end. | More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: At the end. | As to my actual physical being, I was neither conscious or alert.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My field of vision was extensive and the brightness of the colors was intense.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I didn't meet any other humans. There was just a ‘presence’ that was with me. I didn't know the identity of the presence. The presence said, ‘Don't be afraid, you will no longer have any worries or cares’. | No A presence that communicated with me, as I have explained above.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light was very bright but not blinding. | Yes This is hard to describe. It was bright but not blinding.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Not a distinctive location, just a beautiful field with colorful flowers, tree and brook and white bridge. | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was a beautiful field with flowers and trees and a creek and then a bridge. Maybe not "distinctive" like a house.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Calmness, yet I knew it was important. | Peace. Freedom. Awe.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Moderate | Moderate United Church of Christ
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: No | Yes I am a Christian but don't feel guilty about not going to church. I do not consider myself to be ‘religious’ but have a very deep and abiding faith in God.
elements.What is your religion now?: Liberal | Liberal United Church of Christ
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: No | Yes I am a Christian but don't feel guilty about not going to church. I do not consider myself to be ‘religious’ but have a very deep and abiding faith in God.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I have no doubt about there being something else after death. I also realized after the experience that I felt the loss of loved ones but knew they were in a much better place, so my grieving became very different. | Yes Not to fear death. I've had an illness since and sat with so many loved ones as they died. It was only because I knew they were going to be okay that I could sit with them.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I believe I am now more caring and sympathetic to others. | Yes In general I knew I should be kinder to everyone but I don't want people to take advantage of me.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I believe I am now more caring and sympathetic to others. After the NDE | tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes In general I knew I should be kinder to everyone but I don't want people to take advantage of me. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I knew it was very real but I thought at first others would think I was crazy. After I had read an excerpt from a book by E. Kubler Ross, I thought that if I told my doctors about it they would suggest there was some scientific reason for it. I still think anyone that hasn't had this experience would not believe it. | Uncertain At the time, I had never read or heard about near death experiences. I thought people would think I was crazy or put their own interpretation on it.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I think I have a little bit of extra sensory perception or ESP for short. | No
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The whole experience was very meaningful. I had no fear of death afterwards. | The whole experience was meaningful to me. About 25 years later, I was seriously ill and heard the doctors say they didn't know if I would make it and it bothered me that the presence hadn't come for me. I wondered if it was because I had not crossed that bridge before that I would not get a second chance.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes About ten years later my best friend lost her father and I told her. At the time I didn't know if she believed me but some years later she said she was in church, a gentleman shared a very similar experience with her, and she called to tell me about it. I think she had been influenced by our conversation years earlier. I also have shared just a little of it, with someone who lost a child. I think it brought them some peace. I am very careful who I share it with because, if they are grieving the loss of a loved one, I don't want them to think they can take a shortcut by ending their own life. | Yes It was many years later - maybe 6 or 7 years. We were at a family camp and one of my children asked if I believed in heaven. I said I didn't know if there was heaven for sure but I knew there was something after a person dies. I didn't go into detail because of their age. Also when a close friend lost her father 8-10 years later, I told her about my experience and I didn't know what she thought about it. Last year she called to tell me about a man in her church who told the congregation about his NDE and she had remembered what I had told her all those years earlier, so she must have taken me seriously. I've been careful over the years who I tell about it.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I knew it was real but I thought if I told anyone they would think I was crazy. | Experience was definitely real I just knew I knew it was real. I did not think anyone else would understand though.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real No matter who tries to explain it away they will never make me believe it was anything other than ‘definitely real’. | Experience was definitely real Only I know how very real it was to me. It was NOT a deep dream or the result of some pre-conditioning of what I might have expected to happen.
